excerpt.before:
entories 

 Inventories are recorded at the lower of cost or net realizable value, with cost determined on a first-in, first-out basis. We periodically review our inventories to identify obsolete, slow-moving, excess or otherwise unsaleable items. If obsolete, slow-moving, excess or unsaleable items are observed and there are no alternate uses for the inventory, we record a write-down to net realizable value through a charge to Cost of goods sold on our Consolidated Statements of Operations. The determination of net realizable value requires judgment, including consideration of many factors, such as estimates of future product demand, product net selling prices, current and future market conditions and potential product obsolescence, among others. Inventories that are not expected to be sold within 12 months are classified in Other long-term assets on our Consolidated Balance Sheets.

memo_points.text: Gilead's own deal terms set a high bar for anito-cel: Arcellx holders get a $300M CVR only if anito-cel reaches $6.0B of cumulative sales from launch (revenue from early 2027) through 2029, about $2.0B a year, more than Gilead's whole shrinking cell therapy line and close to JNJ's Carvykti run-rate. Impact: nugget dRev (bull, base, bear) (1,000, 1,000, 1,500) x CM 1.00 x (1 - t 0.1854) / D 1,243.0 (line revenue; estimate from nugget GILD-nugget-007).

Gilead widened its Biktarvy price-spillover warning in May 2026 to 'potentially other segments' (beyond Medicaid rebates and 340B ceiling prices), and the Medicare set price that triggers it lands on January 1, 2028, eight years before the April 2036 generic date management keeps citing; no Gilead call or slide in the corpus frames that gap. The selection itself is public: Biktarvy has been in the CMS selected-drug file since January 27, 2026 (IPAY 2028, MFP blank) and is already a row in Aidan's model, so this row claims only the spillover wording and the 2028 vs 2036 gap. Gilead's own risk factor says the price will be 'substantially lower'. Impact: nugget dRev (bull, base, bear) (204, 511, 818) x CM 1.00 x (1 - t 0.1854) / D 1,243.0 (line revenue; estimate from nugget GILD-nugget-001).

Biktarvy's Medicare price is set by negotiation from January 2028: CMS Part B+D spend $3,904.5M; assumed base list discount 65.5% (median of the cycle 1-2 negotiated discounts in the CMS fact sheets; cited range 38% to 85%; no same-class MFP published). US generic entry no earlier than April 1, 2036 under the patent settlements (10-K), not the earlier 2033 projection, so the set price runs eight years before generics. Bear precedent for the first set-price year: Amgen's ENBREL net selling price fell 22% under Part D price setting; bull precedent: BMS cut the Eliquis list price and Eliquis revenue rose 22% in its first set-price year. questions.q: Which of the three forces hits Gilead Sciences hardest?

answer.text: Gilead widened its Biktarvy price-spillover warning in May 2026 to 'potentially other segments' (beyond Medicaid rebates and 340B ceiling prices), and the Medicare set price that triggers it lands on January 1, 2028, eight years before the April 2036 generic date management keeps citing; no Gilead call or slide in the corpus frames that gap. The selection itself is public: Biktarvy has been in the CMS selected-drug file since January 27, 2026 (IPAY 2028, MFP blank) and is already a row in Aidan's model, so this row claims only the spillover wording and the 2028 vs 2036 gap. Gilead's own risk factor says the price will be 'substantially lower'. Impact: nugget dRev (bull, base, bear) (204, 511, 818) x CM 1.00 x (1 - t 0.1854) / D 1,243.0 (line revenue; estimate from nugget GILD-nugget-001). Biktarvy's Medicare price is set by negotiation from January 2028: CMS Part B+D spend $3,904.5M; assumed base list discount 65.5% (median of the cycle 1-2 negotiated discounts in the CMS fact sheets; cited range 38% to 85%; no same-class MFP published). US generic entry no earlier than April 1, 2036 under the patent settlements (10-K), not the earlier 2033 projection, so the set price runs eight years before generics. Bear precedent for the first set-price year: Amgen's ENBREL net selling price fell 22% under Part D price setting; bull precedent: BMS cut the Eliquis list price and Eliquis revenue rose 22% in its first set-price year. Impact: G 3,904.486 x max(0, k (1.0, 1.0, 1.0) x d (0.38, 0.655, 0.85) - m_avoided (0.2, 0.15, 0.1)) (class rule: low-rebate class). Between the February 2026 10-K and the May 2026 10-Q, Gilead's description of its MFN deal changed from MFN prices 'in Medicaid for select existing and future launched products' to 'MFN prices in the U.S. market for future launched products', and the tariff exemption became conditional on more US investment; the ~2% 2026 HIV policy headwind on the slides names only ACA and the pricing agreement, while at least five products launch inside the deal's three-year term. Impact: nugget dRev (bull, base, bear) (225, 225, 450) x CM 0.70 x (1 - t 0.1854) / D 1,243.0 (line revenue; estimate from nugget GILD-nugget-003).
